name: Zora Tunic
description: Blue tunic woven from Zora scales. Grants the ability to breathe underwater indefinitely. Essential for Water Temple and Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

customData.location: Zora's Domain (melt King Zora) / Ice Cavern
customData.lore: Woven from the finest Zora scales by the royal tailors. The fabric filters oxygen from water like gills.
puzzleUses: Dive to bottom of Lake Hylia
